name: Non-syndromic Terminal Transverse Limb Defect

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Non-syndromic Terminal Transverse Limb Defect Diagnostic Criteria

criteria.description: Presence of a transverse limb defect involving the terminal portion of one or more limbs without associated syndromic features
No clinical or radiological evidence of syndromic anomalies or systemic involvement
Radiographic evidence confirming transverse limb deficiency at terminal limb segments
Absence or presence of family history consistent with isolated limb defect

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria must be met: terminal transverse limb defect without syndromic features confirmed by radiographic imaging.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires exclusion of syndromic causes and other limb malformation syndromes.

pathognomonic.notes: Complete absence of distal limb structures distal to a transverse plane
searchTerms: transverse limb loss at terminal part

pathognomonic.symptomName: Isolated limb involvement without systemic anomalies
pathognomonic.notes: No associated malformations in other organ systems
searchTerms: limb problem only, no other body issues

common.notes: Typically affects one limb more frequently than multiple limbs

common.symptomName: Shortened residual limb segment proximal to defect
common.notes: Residual limb may be hypoplastic or shortened

common.symptomName: Normal skin covering at defect margin
common.notes: Skin at the terminal defect is typically intact without ulceration
searchTerms: normal skin at limb defect edge
intact skin around missing limb area

common.notes: No facial dysmorphism or cranial abnormalities

occasional.notes: Discrepancy in length between affected and unaffected limbs
searchTerms: one limb shorter than the other

occasional.symptomName: Limited range of motion in adjacent joints
occasional.notes: Reduced mobility in joints proximal to the defect
Occasional skin irritation due to prosthetic use or friction
searchTerms: redness or soreness on limb stump

occasional.notes: Secondary spinal curvature due to limb length discrepancy

rare.notes: Rare cases involve both upper or both lower limbs
Occasional neuropathic symptoms in residual limb
searchTerms: burning or shooting pain in residual limb

rare.notes: Rare reports of phantom limb phenomena

imaging: Radiographs demonstrating transverse terminal limb deficiency
Absence of bone distal to a transverse plane in affected limb
genetic: No consistent genetic mutation identified; sporadic cases predominate
Genetic testing to exclude syndromic limb malformation genes recommended
other: Clinical examination confirming isolated limb defect without systemic involvement

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of constriction rings or fibrous bands
Associated skin scarring and distal swelling
Often asymmetric and variable limb involvement
Additional skeletal anomalies beyond terminal limb defects
Presence of systemic or craniofacial anomalies
Genetic mutations identified in known syndromes

redFlags: Presence of systemic anomalies suggesting syndromic diagnosis
Rapid progression or worsening of limb defect postnatally
Signs of vascular compromise or ischemia in residual limb
references: Orphanet: Non-syndromic Terminal Transverse Limb Defect, ORPHA:498461
Hunter AGW, et al. Limb Deficiencies. In: Emery’s Elements of Medical Genetics. 15th ed. 2019.
